agent_profile_snapshot.description: Converts supported artifact representations without changing the analytical meaning of the data. CSV-to-points requires explicit coordinate-field names and a source CRS.

skills.name: Format and Spatial Conversion
skills.description: Converts data formats between GeoJSON and GeoPackage, spatializes coordinate tables into vector point layers, and exports tabular data.

constraints.spatial: CSV-to-points requires latitude and longitude fields and assigns a documented source CRS.
other: The service does not fabricate missing records or infer unknown CRS definitions.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.

input_datasets.description: GeoPackage vector dataset(s) and optional CSV attribute table.

operation.description: Explicit operation name (dissolve, spatial_join, attribute_join, buffer, aggregate, point_count_by_polygon, point_sum_by_polygon).

sum_field.description: Point-layer numeric field to sum for point_sum_by_polygon.

vector_key.description: Field name in vector dataset for attribute join.

table_key.description: Field name in tabular dataset for attribute join.
